annotations.title: Full Dutch income tax return estimate (Box 1, Box 3, partner, mortgage, treaty relief)

description: Estimates the whole 2026 Dutch income tax return: Box 1 salary tax with the tax credits and the 30% ruling, the own home (eigenwoningforfait and mortgage interest, with the best split between fiscal partners), Box 3 on savings and investments, and tax-treaty relief for real estate abroad (exempt in the Netherlands). With the payroll tax already withheld it says whether you get money back or have to pay.

debts.description: Box 3 debts on 1 January (not the own-home mortgage)

foreign_property_country.description: ISO country code of that property, e.g. IN, GB, US, ES. Default: other (the same relief applies without a treaty).

foreign_property_value.description: Value of real estate abroad (already included in investments), for treaty relief

gross_annual.description: Gross annual salary in euros, without holiday allowance

holiday_allowance_on_top.description: Add the 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

investments.description: Investments and other assets on 1 January, INCLUDING the value of any property abroad

mortgage_interest_annual.description: Mortgage interest paid in the year on the own home, euros

partner_gross_annual.description: Fiscal partner's gross annual salary (filing together). Omit for a single filer.

partner_payroll_tax_withheld.description: Payroll tax withheld for the partner. Optional.

payroll_tax_withheld.description: Payroll tax (loonheffing) withheld in the year, from the annual statement (jaaropgaaf). Optional: without it no refund/payment is given.

savings.description: Savings on 1 January (couple total if filing together)

woz_value.description: WOZ value of the own home (main residence). Omit if renting.
